title: ecdh_wrap_cek match on kek_len duplicates identical blocks for 16 vs 32
description: ecdh_wrap_cek() has two nearly identical arms in a match on kek_len. The only differences are the slice-to-array coercions and the KwAes128 vs KwAes256 type. A macro or a sealed trait on the key-wrap type could eliminate the duplication. Suggested rewrite: extract a wrap_with_aes_kw(kek: &[u8], cek: &[u8], out: &mut [u8]) -> Result<(), Error> that dispatches by length internally, keeping ecdh_wrap_cek clean.
